user.title: Sign in to Carrier SmartHome
user.description: Uses Carrier's native GraphQL cloud API. Supports SmartHome entry-level thermostats only. No Matter. Your password is stored in Home Assistant's configuration storage for authentication and session renewal.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Carrier SmartHome
reauth_confirm.description: Your Carrier session needs to be reauthenticated.

error.invalid_auth: Carrier did not accept the credentials or login method.
error.cannot_connect: The Carrier SmartHome API could not be reached or returned an unexpected response.
error.no_devices: Login succeeded, but Carrier returned no entry-level thermostats for this account.

abort.already_configured: This Carrier account is already configured.

init.title: Carrier SmartHome options
init.description: Carrier native cloud controls: choose mode/power, fan Auto/On, and temperature target capabilities independently. Commands require Carrier online status, send one mutation, and verify readback. No duplicate mode/fan entities. Fan Circulation and other unverified values are not exposed. No Matter.

data.enable_control: Enable experimental HVAC mode and power control
data.power_on_mode: HVAC Power ON mode (Heat / Cool / Auto / Fan Only; Unset blocks turn-on)
data.enable_setpoint_control: Separately enable experimental temperature setpoint changes
data.enable_fan_control: Enable experimental fan Auto / On control (real equipment command)

error.setpoints_require_mode_control: Enable HVAC mode/power control before enabling temperature setpoint changes.
